name: GitLab
description: GitLab repo host channel (gitlab.com or self-hosted). Connection stub used by gitlab-channel and any future GitLab-aware extension.
long_description:
Channel stub that represents the GitLab integration surface. Other extensions declare it as a dependency to signal they need an authenticated GitLab client (today: gitlab-channel; future: ci-watcher, release-notifier, …).

Configuration (host + Personal/Project Access Token with 'api' scope) is held by the gitlab-channel extension because it owns the runtime that uses it.
